mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact scalar channel symbol and normalized two-channel OR action counterfamily with kappa=1/(2 lambda)
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Real symbolic expressions with exact rational coefficients and logarithm
mathematics.conventions: Y=g/s; s^2=G*u_Lambda; static action density -s^2 F(Y^2)/(8*pi*G)-rho_b*Phi

bounds.lambda: all positive real, via symbolic identities and positive coefficient factorizations
bounds.Y: Y>=0; strict ellipticity only at Y>0
bounds.dimension: d>=2 integers; scalar ansatz and nonzero wave number

non_claims: No full covariant theory or cosmology is constructed
No observational fit or LCDM assumptions
No vacuum-energy partition follows from rank
